# Christian Vari

> Security Researcher — Founder & CEO of Codezen, Head of Audit Operations at Oak Security. Securing blockchain protocols, consensus engines, cross-chain bridges, smart contracts, financial systems. 122 completed audits and 1693 issues found across Solana, Cosmos SDK, Polkadot SDK, Ethereum and EVM.

Markdown versions of every page are available; prefer them over the HTML.

- [Profile](https://www.christianvari.dev/index.md): bio, experience, education, patent, expertise, selected audits, achievements, certifications and contact
- [Audits](https://www.christianvari.dev/audits.md): every audit with type, partner, issue counts and report links
- [Full context](https://www.christianvari.dev/llms-full.txt): profile and all audits in a single file
